summary: Iteration 5 backend testing of Supabase JWT auth migration. All 20 pytest tests PASSED (100%). Verified: JWT signature verification (missing/garbage/wrong-secret/wrong-aud/expired/no-bearer-prefix all → 401; valid → 200), first-time user upsert with correct defaults (consent_accepted=false, onboarding_complete=false, current_phase=0), name fallback to email prefix when user_metadata.name is absent, idempotent /auth/me calls (no duplicate rows), profile update persistence via PUT /api/profile → GET /api/auth/me round-trip, journal CRUD, dashboard.context, memory-path returns {stones: []} for a new user, /phases returns 4 phases, safety contacts create+list, somatic-practices seeded (8), journal/prompt string. Removed endpoints POST /api/auth/session and POST /api/auth/logout both return 405 (Method Not Allowed) as expected. No _id leaks in any inspected response. Replaced obsolete conftest.py that seeded `qa-token-xyz` in user_sessions; deleted the three stale iteration-1..4 test files.

minor.issue: Dead code: EMERGENT_SESSION_DATA_URL = "" constant and the SessionRequest Pydantic model are leftovers from the Emergent OAuth flow. Safe to remove for cleanliness.
AuthResponse model (session_token + user) is defined but no endpoint returns it anymore. Dead code post-migration.

Module docstring still says 'Auth: Emergent-managed Google OAuth (session_token flow, 7-day expiry).' — should be updated to 'Auth: Supabase-issued HS256 JWTs verified locally with SUPABASE_JWT_SECRET.'

action_items: OPTIONAL cleanup: remove dead code in server.py — EMERGENT_SESSION_DATA_URL constant, SessionRequest model, and AuthResponse model (no functional impact, but keeps the file honest post-migration).
OPTIONAL: update the module docstring at the top of server.py to describe the Supabase JWT flow instead of the Emergent OAuth flow.
No functional fixes required — the Supabase JWT migration is working correctly end-to-end on the backend.
critical_code_review_comments: get_current_user() correctly verifies HS256 signature with SUPABASE_JWT_SECRET, enforces aud="authenticated", handles missing/expired/malformed tokens with 401, and upserts a Mongo user document keyed by `sub`. Race-condition handling on concurrent first-time upsert is present.
All Mongo find() calls use projection {"_id": 0} — confirmed no _id leaks across the entire tested surface area (dashboard, journal, memory-path, phases, safety, users).
Name fallback chain (user_metadata.name → user_metadata.full_name → email prefix → 'friend') is robust.
Backend .env has all required Supabase keys. Frontend .env has EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY for the client-side supabase-js SDK.
server.py is 1024 lines — slightly over the 700-line guideline; consider splitting into routers (auth, journal, phases, safety, memory_path) in a future refactor. Not blocking.
seed_data_creation: conftest.py auto-wipes the QA user (sub=11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111) before and after the session; no persistent seed data required — JWTs are minted on demand.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth is now Supabase JWT-based. Use `make_jwt(...)` from tests/conftest.py to mint tokens. NEVER expect POST /api/auth/session or POST /api/auth/logout — they return 405. The QA user's sub is 11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111 (email qa+iter5@projectlife.local). MongoDB collection `user_sessions` is dropped by the session fixture — do not rely on it. All endpoints require Authorization: Bearer <supabase_jwt>.
